top_signals.title: India Protests Set to Continue Despite Heavy Delhi Security
top_signals.summary: Parts of New Delhi remained under tight security for a second straight day as protesters pressed ahead with their demand for the resignation of India’s top election official over a contentious revision of voter rolls.
